name: Atlanta
lede: From the friendliest par-3 course in the region to a championship-caliber test near downtown — Atlanta's courses cover every level. We're publishing the metro's best first.
introParagraphs: Atlanta disc golf spans the whole spectrum. Oregon Park in Marietta is the region's favorite beginner course — 18 gentle par 3s where a huge slice of Atlanta's players took their first putts. Little Mulberry in Dacula is the wooded technical step up, and East Roswell's tight fairways and hills teach accuracy the hard way.

Perkerson Park near downtown is the championship test — a John Ritger design that the locals call the most challenging of the city's top tracks. The Sunday Service league is one of the biggest weekly events in the Southeast, and the Atlanta disc golf community is one of the most active in the country. Nearly all of Atlanta's mapped courses are free to play.
New here? Oregon Park to learn, then Little Mulberry, then Perkerson when you're ready. For gear, Full Blast Disc Golf Pro Shop at North Landing and Play It Again Sports are the local options.

faqs.question: How many disc golf courses are in the Atlanta metro?
faqs.answer: There are 52 courses across the Atlanta metro, mapped and live on FindFrolf, with more added every week.

faqs.question: What's the best disc golf course in Atlanta?
faqs.answer: Little Mulberry in Dacula is the highest-rated published course, but Perkerson Park near downtown is the one serious players measure themselves against.

faqs.question: Are Atlanta's disc golf courses free?
faqs.answer: Most are. 48 of the 52 mapped courses are free to play, and 4 are pay-to-play. Check each course page for its current green fee.

faqs.question: What's the best beginner course in Atlanta?
faqs.answer: Oregon Park in Marietta — the friendliest par-3 course in the region and where most local players started. JP Moseley is another approachable option.

faqs.question: Where can I buy disc golf gear in Atlanta?
faqs.answer: Full Blast Disc Golf Pro Shop at North Landing is the dedicated shop. Play It Again Sports in Sandy Springs carries new and used discs.
